sources.games: 829 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 49.5%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py slardar.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 28 (Guardian Sprint, Slithereen Crush, Bash of the Deep, Corrosive Haze), 7.41f.

rules.name: Black King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Black King Bar: Avatar applies a basic dispel, 60% magic resistance and makes negative effects of enemy spells do nothing for 9/8/7 s. It is in his build (78% of the won games, ~25 min); Pipe of Insight is not.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, so their spells cannot stop your Slithereen Crush
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, щоб їхні здібності не зупинили ваш Slithereen Crush

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 92% (2), magic_wand 85% (6), power_treads 97% (7), soul_ring 75% (10), aghanims_shard 97% (17), echo_sabre 24% (20), great_famango 22% (22), black_king_bar 78% (25), ultimate_scepter 52% (31), buckler 25% (35), nullifier 25% (36).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 20:00 11000 (20 games, 80.0%), 30:00 16500 (46 games, 80.4%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then lead the fights and take objectives with your team
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім ведіть бійки й беріть об'єкти разом із командою
